{{Quote|The day I picked up the Crescent, I could have flown without thrusters and knocked out TIE Interceptors just by spitting at them.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="XW:WS" />}}
The '''Kalidor Crescent''' was a prestigious award given to those who served in the military forces of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The medal was named after a [[Kalidor/Legends|winged predator]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Davnar II/Legends|Davnar II]] and was only given to pilots who had performed beyond the call of duty, displaying both skill and bravery in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]]. For continued acts of heroism, recipients could earn upgraded classes of the award. Recipients of the Kalidor Crescent and its variations were among the most famed members of the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]], including [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]], and [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Tono Porkins]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Your exploits in the last mission have earned you the Kalidor Crescent, the most prestigious individual mission award. Well done.|Commander [[Zaletta]]|audio=ZalettaKalidor-XWA.flac|<ref name="SW:XWA" />}}
[[File:KalidorCrescent.png|thumb|left|200px|Kalidor Crescent with Bronze Cluster, Silver Talons, Silver Scimitar, Golden Wings and Diamond Eyes]]
The Kalidor Crescent comprised a large, weighty medallion suspended from a wide ribbon. The intricately engraved medallion was made of [[Gold/Legends|gold]]-plated alloy in the shape of an inverted crescent with a smooth [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] held at the bottom by the points of the crescent.<ref name="LBE">''[[Lead by Example]]''</ref> The design was intended to resemble a [[Kalidor/Legends|kalidor]] in inverted flight, with its curving wings surrounding the gemstone.<ref name="XW:WS" /> The [[Color/Legends|color]] of the gemstone varied depending on which branch of the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] the recipient served in, with a green gem used for the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]<ref name="LBE" /> and [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]]<ref name="SW:XW" /><ref name="SW:XWA" /> and a blue gem used for the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]].<ref name="LBE" /> Amber gems were used in the Kalidor Crescent by the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="XW:WS" /> Engraved on the reverse side of the medallion in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] were the words "For Conspicuous Gallantry."<ref name="LBE" />

Above the medallion was a royal blue ribbon with a red stripe along both edges which was a single piece for around ten [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] before splitting in two with each piece ending in half of an alloy clasp. Attached to the ribbon above the medallion was a large likeness of a kalidor made of the same material as the medallion itself. The kalidor was depicted looking to right with its wings spread wide.<ref name="LBE" /> The medal also came with a longer ceremonial [[Silk/Legends|silk]] ribbon, which was used to place the medal around the recipient's neck.<ref name="XW:WS" /> However, the medal was not generally worn for everyday duties and many recipients stored the award in a metal case when not wearing it.<ref name="SW:XWA" />

For each subsequent award of the Kalidor Crescent to a previous recipient, individuals were given a small embellishment for their existing medal. In order of precedence, these were:<ref name="XW:OSG" />

*[[Bronze Cluster/Legends|Bronze Cluster]]: The Bronze Cluster was a small group of three bronze stars<ref name="LBE" /> which were attached to the ribbon between the gem and the kalidor.<ref name="SW:XWA" />
*[[Silver Talons/Legends|Silver Talons]]: The Silver Talons added a set of silver claws to the kalidor mold on the ribbon.<ref name="SW:XWA" />
*[[Silver Scimitar/Legends|Silver Scimitar]]: The Silver Scimatar was a small figure of a curved [[Sword/Legends|sword]] which attached to the top bar of the ribbon.<ref name="SW:XWA" />
*[[Golden Wings/Legends|Golden Wings]]: The Golden Wings were a set of solid gold wings<ref name="LBE" /> which were attached above and to either side of the kalidor.<ref name="SW:XWA" />
*[[Diamond Eyes/Legends|Diamond Eyes]]: The Diamond Eyes were a pair of small diamonds which were attached to the ribbon above the kalidor.<ref name="SW:XWA" /> As of the start of [[Operation Strike Fear]], nobody had ever earned the Diamond Eyes.<ref name="XW:OSG" />
*[[Kenobi Medallion]]: The Kenobi Medallion was a bronze device.<ref name="Insider74" />

==History==
The Kalidor Crescent was introduced by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to recognize [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who had displayed exceptional feats of both bravery and skill. The medal was named after the famed kalidor, a winged predator from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Davnar II/Legends|Davnar II]], to commemorate its grace and power. The bird's precise aerial maneuvers represented the standards expected of Rebel starfighter pilots.<ref name="XW:OSG" /> Although it was originally intended for members of the Alliance Starfighter Corps, the medal's use evolved over time and it came to be awarded to those who served the Alliance in other disciplines, including members of the Alliance Army.<ref name="LBE" />

[[File:FarlanderMedal.png|thumb|right|250px|Kalidor Crescent presentation ceremony]]
Awarded for "conspicuous and intrepid gallantry at the risk of life above and beyond the call of duty," the Kalidor Crescent was the highest honor awarded by the Rebel Alliance, rated above the [[Corellian Cross/Legends|Corellian Cross]] and [[Illudium Star/Legends|Illudium Star]]. Nominations for the medal had to be submitted by either one of the recipient's superior [[Officer/Legends|officers]] or a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] or other civilian representative of the [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Alliance Civil Government]]. Such was the importance of the award that it only presented by the Alliance's [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], or the [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the Alliance Military.<ref name="LBE" />

As a result of the high standards required for nomination, the Kalidor Crescent was usually awarded [[Death/Legends|posthumously]].<ref name="LBE" /> Living recipients of the award were regarded with great respect and achieved a degree of celebrity status among their peers.<ref name="XW:OSG" /> Living recipients who were still in active service could be awarded the Kalidor Crescent again for further acts of gallantry and heroism.<ref name="LBE" /> Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="XW:OSG" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> there were a total of five such further decorations: the Bronze Cluster, the Silver Talons, the Silver Scimitar, the Golden Wings, and the Diamond Eyes.<ref name="XW:OSG" /> Following the Alliance's victory against the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] at the Battle of Yavin,<ref name="GG1" /> the Rebels created the Kenobi Medallion as a further enhancement to the Kalidor Crescent.<ref name="Insider74" /> The Kenobi Medallion was only initially awarded posthumously to those who had sacrificed their lives in the fight against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was first presented to the casualties among [[Great Temple/Legends|Yavin Base's]] pilots.<ref name="GG1" /> The Kenobi Medallion was later presented to surviving personnel.<ref name="Insider74" />

The [[Medal of Alderaan]] was later commissioned by Mon Mothma to honor specific heroes of the Alliance and held a level of prestige similar to that of the Kalidor Crescent.<ref name="LBE" /> After the death of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and the rise of the New Republic, the medal continued to be awarded to members of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]], and remained a mark of prestige.<ref name="XW:WS" />

==Notable recipients==
===Wedge Antilles===
{{Main|Wedge Antilles/Legends}}
[[File:Wedge_Antilles.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Wedge Antilles]]
Wedge Antilles was the son of [[Jagged Antilles|Jagged]] and [[Zena Antilles]], operators of a refueling platform on the [[Gus Treta Inner-System Market Station|Gus Treta]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. By the time he was seventeen, Antilles had become a capable pilot and often worked with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Booster Terrik]]. He was aboard Terrik's ''[[Pulsar Skate]]'' when the pirate [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Buzzzer (starship)|''Buzzzer'']] attempted to flee a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] patrol without disengaging from his parents' refueling platform first. Antilles's parents were killed when the station caught fire. Antilles eventually joined the Rebel Alliance, serving as a pilot in [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]]. Based out of Yavin Base, Antilles was one of the few survivors of the Battle of Yavin, getting half a dozen kills during the battle before damage to his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] forced him to withdraw.<ref name="NEGC" />

After the Battle of Yavin, Antilles jointly founded [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Antilles took command of the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="NEGC" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="NEC" /> At the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Antilles saw combat against a [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. Accompanied by the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], Antilles flew his X-wing into the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] superstructure and the two [[Starship/Legends|ships]] destroyed its [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]].<ref name="NEGC" />

Antilles remained in command of Rogue Squadron after the Alliance became the New Republic, playing an important part in the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberation]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the defeat of the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]], before leaving to found [[Wraith Squadron]]. He eventually accepted a promotion to [[General/Legends|general]] and continued to serve the New Republic into the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="NEGC" /> Antilles was awarded the Kalidor Crescent at some point before [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="XW:WS" />

===Ace Azzameen===
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance}}
{{Main|Ace Azzameen/Legends}}
[[File:RebelPilotHeadOnPortrait-XWA.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Ace Azzameen]]
Ace Azzameen was originally a freighter pilot for his [[Azzameen family|family's]] business, [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]]. When his [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|father]] and [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|older brother]] were killed while assisting the Rebellion shortly after the Battle of Hoth, Azzameen, his brother [[Emon Azzameen|Emon]], and sister [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]] found themselves on the run from the Empire. Azzameen joined the Alliance as a starfighter pilot, serving aboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] and [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], and participating in several battles, including the defeat of the [[TIE Experimental Project]]. He later worked with Luke Skywalker, [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]], and the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] to capture the [[Death Star II plans|plans]] to the Death Star II. When the Alliance attacked the battlestation at the Battle of Endor, Azzameen was assigned to the crew of the ''Millennium Falcon'' under General [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. The ''Falcon'' played a critical part in the battle, entering the Death Star's superstructure and destroying its reactor core. Azzameen received the Kalidor Crescent at some time during his first year in the Alliance.<ref name="SW:XWA" />
{{Endgame}}

===Keyan Farlander===
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)}}
{{Quote|Congratulations on behalf of the Rebel Alliance.|Mon Mothma presents the Kalidor Crescent to Keyan Farlander|audio=KalidorMothmaCongratulations-XW.flac|<ref name="SW:XW" />}}
{{Main|Keyan Farlander/Legends}}
[[File:FarlanderLegacy.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Keyan Farlander]]
Keyan Farlander was a native of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. After his parents were killed in an Imperial attack, Farlander attended a recruitment rally by Alliance Chief of State Mon Mothma and joined the Alliance Starfighter Corps shortly after the [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]]. Serving in Red Squadron aboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']], Farlander participated in many early battles of the Galactic Civil War, helping to defeat Operation Strike Fear, capture the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Priam (starship)|''Priam'']], and destroy the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Intrepid (Imperial I-class)|''Intrepid'']]. He was one of several pilots transferred from the ''Independence'' to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] ahead of the Battle of Yavin and one of the few survivors of that battle.<ref name="XW:OSG" />

Farlander later aided in the development of the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] and protected Rebel forces as they moved to their new [[Echo Base/Legends|base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="XW:OSG" /> Farlander was awarded the Kalidor Crescent at some point prior to the Battle of Hoth in a ceremony presided over by Mon Mothma.<ref name="SW:XW" /> He later fought against the second Death Star at the Battle of Endor,<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|text=''Star Wars Evolutions''|pack=Rebel Pilot Legacy (Series 2)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tlcEVORebelPilots2.asp}}</ref> before serving the New Republic during the Yuuzhan Vong War, both as a general<ref name="dw">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="wwnjo">{{InsiderCite|57|Who's Who in the New Jedi Order}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

===Toryn Farr===
{{Main|Toryn Farr/Legends}}
[[File:Toryn-hd.png|thumb|right|150px|Toryn Farr]]
Toryn Farr was the chief communications officer assigned to the command center of Echo Base on Hoth when the Galactic Empire attacked in 3 ABY. Farr gave the order for the base's [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] to open fire on the approaching [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]<ref name="TorynDB">{{DB|character|torynfarr|Farr, Toryn}}</ref> and was among the last Rebel personnel to evacuate the base aboard the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] [[Bright Hope/Legends|''Bright Hope'']], along with her sister, [[Samoc Farr/Legends|Samoc]]. When the ship was disabled while attempting to escape, Farr found herself as the senior officer out of the 108 surviving passengers and took charge of the situation. Farr decided to use the ship's three [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] to carry eighteen survivors back to Hoth in the hopes that they could survive until the Alliance came looking for them. Choosing not to go herself, Farr remained aboard the ''Bright Hope'' to help the remaining survivors destroy all sensitive data before the Imperials could board and seize it. However, when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] and [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] boarded the ''Bright Hope'', Farr was able to convince them to carry the remaining ninety survivors safely to the Rebel underground on [[Darlyn Boda/Legends|Darlyn Boda]].<ref name="OPF">{{StoryCite|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> Her bravery and initiative under duress led General [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] to award her the Kalidor Crescent, along with a promotion to commander.<ref name="Insider74" /> Her determination to save as many Echo Base personnel as possible was further demonstrated by her request to lead a [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Special Forces]] team back to the ice-world in an attempt to recover her comrades from the escape pods.<ref name="OPF" />

===Reyé Hollis===
{{Main|Reyé Hollis/Legends}}
[[File:GoneWithTheBlizzard-ESB.png|thumb|right|150px|Reyé Hollis]]
Reyé Hollis was raised on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and became a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the Alliance Army during the Galactic Civil War. By 3 ABY, he was assigned to Echo Base on Hoth, serving under [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ledick Firest/Legends|Ledick Firest]], and had already been awarded the Kalidor Crescent. During the Battle of Hoth, Hollis further distinguished himself by rescuing a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] who had been cut off from their comrades, saving two medics from an advancing [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]], and was wounded while covering his [[Company/Legends|company's]] retreat. His actions earned him a Kenobi Medallion for his Kalidor Crescent, along with a promotion.<ref name="Insider74" />

===Halley Kadorto===
{{Main|Halley Kadorto}}
Halley Kadorto was born during the final decades of the Galactic Republic and became a veteran of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the rise of the Galactic Empire, Kadorto joined the fledgling Rebel Alliance as a pilot, surviving many missions and narrowly escaping death several times in the then-unreliable Rebel starfighters.<ref name="XW:OSG" /> Kadorto was awarded the Kalidor Crescent for his role in the [[Rescue at Mon Calamari|rescue]] of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] as they waited to be transferred to the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer [[Warrior (Star Destroyer)|''Warrior'']] above [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. The Rebels had planned to complete the operation before the ''Warrior'' arrived, but its early arrival jeopardized the mission as the Star Destroyer launched [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] to destroy the freighters carrying the slaves and keep them from joining the Rebels. Kadorto responded quickly, singlehandedly eliminating waves of TIEs until Rebel forces could rescue the slaves.<ref name="SW:XW" />

===Nien Nunb===
{{Main|Nien Nunb/Legends}}
[[File:Nien_Nunb.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Nien Nunb]]
A native of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], Nien Nunb worked as a cargo pilot for [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] until the company's Imperial allegiances prompted him to quit his job. When the company retaliated by attempting to have him killed, Nunb became a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], conducting raids of SoroSuub shipments and giving what he stole to the Rebel Alliance. With the help of his old friend and prominent member of the Alliance, [[Sian Tevv/Legends|Sian Tevv]], Nunb was accepted into the Alliance Fleet and gained a reputation as one of the Rebellion's most trusted pilots. When the Alliance attacked the Death Star II over [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], Nunb was selected to copilot the ''Millennium Falcon'' with Lando Calrissian. The two took the ship into the unfinished battlestation's superstructure and destroyed its reactor core. Nunb's actions at Endor earned him the Kalidor Crescent. Nunb continued to serve the Alliance after Endor before eventually leaving piloting to take a position as Chief Administrator of the [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]], after Calrissian bought the facility. He continued to hold this position into the Yuuzhan Vong War.<ref name="NEGC" />

===Jek Tono Porkins===
{{Main|Jek Tono Porkins/Legends}}
[[File:Porkins.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Jek Porkins]]
Jek Porkins was originally a [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] from the [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]] and a champion [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] pilot on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]]. He had not long gone into business for himself when the Empire decided to establish a base on Bestine IV, forcing the natives to abandon their home and leaving them to wander nomadically through the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. The displaced people of Bestine were offered a home by the fledgling Rebel Alliance, but most rejected the offer, not wanting to leave their home system. Porkins, however, saw that the Rebellion offered him the chance to strike back at the Empire and hoped to one day return and liberate his homeworld. He joined the Alliance as a starfighter pilot and, in less than forty hours of combat flight, gained sixteen confirmed kills. However, his true skill lay in performing strafing runs.<ref name="GG1" />

[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Porkins was stationed at [[Tierfon Rebel Outpost|Tierfon Rebel Base]], along with [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]]. When Janson was called to Yavin Base to fight the Death Star, but was unable to go due to illness, Porkins took his place. Porkins fought in the Battle of Yavin as part of Red Squadron, but a mechanical malfunction left him unable to evade enemy fire. His T-65 X-wing starfighter was hit by an Imperial weapons emplacement, killing Porkins instantly.<ref name="PorkinsDB">{{DB|character|jekredsixporkins|Porkins, Jek (Red Six)}}</ref> Porkins was posthumously awarded the Kenobi Medallion for his part in the battle, which was hung with pride in the pilots' lounge at Tierfon Base.<ref name="GG1" />

===Kell Tainer===
{{Quote|Recently, you were placed in the unenviable position of attempting to save a pilot who had suffered catastrophic damage. I'm not certain that you've ever resigned yourself to the truth that her death does not constitute failure on your part. As a matter of fact, a review of the recordings of the incident by Starfighter Command confirms the fact that your effort demonstrated both unusual courage and enviable piloting skills&mdash;a lesser pilot would have crashed in such an attempt. Therefore, I am pleased to be able to present you with a first for Wraith Squadron: the Kalidor Crescent.|Wedge Antilles presents the Kalidor Crescent to Kell Tainer|<ref name="XW:WS" />}}
{{Main|Kell Tainer}}
[[File:Kelltainer.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Kell Tainer]]
Kell Tainer was born Kell Doran on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. When his father, [[Kissek Doran]], a pilot with the Rebel Alliance, turned coward during a mission and was killed by Wes Janson before he could compromise the operation, Tainer's family changed their surname. Tainer moved to [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] and eventually joined the New Republic. Tainer trained as a demolitions expert and served with [[Katarn Commandos|Page's Commandos]] under [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]] before transferring to [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Command]] to train as a pilot. Two crash-landings during training, both of which he blamed on mechanical failure, threatened to prevent him becoming a pilot, but he was given an opportunity to revive his career when [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] recruited him into Wraith Squadron. Tainer was dismayed to find he would be serving with Wes Janson, whom he still blamed for his father's death. During his time with Wraith Squadron, Tainer was able to overcome the shame he felt about his father, and to accept that Janson was not to blame for what happened.<ref name="XW:WS" />

When Wraith Squadron fought a group of pirates operating out of the [[Red Feathers|''Blood Nest'']] in the [[M2398 system]], [[Jesmin Ackbar]]'s X-wing was damaged by enemy fire, leaving her [[Acceleration compensator/Legends|inertial compensator]] damaged and preventing her from both keeping control of the ship and ejecting to safety. As Ackbar's fighter plummeted towards the surface of the nearby [[Moon/Legends|moon]], Tainer attempted to alter her course by using his [[S-foils/Legends|strike foils]] to nudge her ship away from the surface. Though he was unable to save Ackbar, Tainer's actions earned him the Kalidor Crescent.<ref name="XW:WS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kalidor Crescent was created for the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]. Unlike other medals in the game, which were awarded at the end of each campaign,<ref name="SW:XW" /> the Kalidor Crescent and its embellishments were awarded in order based on the player's score in individual missions as follows:<ref name="XW:OSG" />
*Kalidor Crescent: 10,000<ref name="XW:OSG" />
*Bronze Cluster: 12,000<ref name="XW:OSG" />
*Silver Talons: 14,000<ref name="XW:OSG" />
*Silver Scimitar: 16,000<ref name="XW:OSG" />
*Golden Wings: 18,000<ref name="XW:OSG" />
*Diamond Eyes: 20,000<ref name="XW:OSG" />

The medal also featured in ''X-wing''{{'s}} [[1999]] sequel ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''. This time, however, the medal was not awarded based on scores in individual missions, but rather on the total score from bonus goals achieved throughout the game. As the player's total bonus points reached certain levels, they would be awarded the additions to the basic Kalidor Crescent.<ref name="XWAm">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' manual</ref>

In both ''X-wing'' and ''X-wing Alliance'', the player characters, Keyan Farlander and Ace Azzameen, can only be awarded the Kalidor Crescent and its various upgrades based on player performance. This article assumes that players complete all aspects of the game, achieving the medals in the process.<ref name="XW:OSG" /><ref name="XWAm" />

The only recipient confirmed in the games was Halley Kadorto, who received the medal for one of the missions recreated in ''X-wing''{{'s}} historical simulator.<ref name="SW:XW" /> Kadorto's medal was also mentioned in [[Rusel DeMaria]]'s novella, ''[[The Farlander Papers]]'', which accompanied the game.<ref name="TFP">{{StoryCite|story=The Farlander Papers|book=Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)}}</ref> ''The Farlander Papers'' also provided background information on the medal, which was later repeated in DeMaria's ''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''.<ref name="XW:OSG" /><ref name="TFP" />

The Kalidor Crescent later appeared in [[Aaron Allston]]'s [[1998]] novel, ''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]'', in which Kell Tainer is awarded the medal. The book also established Wedge Antilles as a recipient, though no details of why he was awarded the medal are known.<ref name="XW:WS" /> In ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]], Nien Nunb is established as being awarded the medal following his actions at the Battle of Endor, in which he fought alongside Antilles.<ref name="NEGC" />

The Kenobi Medallion was first mentioned in the [[1989]] [[West End Games]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]'' by [[Grant S. Boucher]]. At the time, it was presented as a standalone medal, with Jek Porkins stated to be a recipient.<ref name="GG1" /> It was not until the [[Star Wars Insider 74|''Star Wars Insider'' 74]] article "[[Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth|Who's Who in Echo Base]]" by [[Josh Radke]] that the Kenobi Medallion was established to be an upgrade to the Kalidor Crescent, and the article established Reyé Hollis as being awarded both. The article also mentioned Toryn Farr's receipt of the Kalidor Crescent.<ref name="Insider74" />
